catalysts.headline: BitMine Immersion Technologies announces ETH holdings reached 6,070,092 tokens (~4.97% of ETH supply), plus 216 BTC, a $180 million Beast Industries equity stake, a $75 million Eightco stake, and $475 million in cash and marketable securities; total crypto, cash and marketable-securities holdings approximately $14.3 billion

Secondary coverage (24/7 Wall St) reports BitMine holds 6,060,506 ETH, ~4.9% of circulating ETH supply, and says the company needs roughly 50,000 more ETH to reach its stated 5%-of-supply ('Alchemy of 5%') target; no primary BitMine press release for this specific figure independently located this session.
catalysts.impact: Continued incremental progress toward the 5% target

catalysts.impact: Incremental accumulation; total-dollar holdings continuing to track ETH spot price moves rather than rising monotonically with token count (consistent with the conflict already on file for the Oct 4-18 window)

conflicts: Cash and marketable securities for the 2026-11-08 disclosure were reported as $475 million in one syndicated copy of the release and $498 million in another syndicated copy of the same release; both figures are recorded, neither resolved.

A StreetInsider article found this session reports BitMine holding only about 3.4 million ETH worth $13.7 billion in total holdings — far below the 6.07 million ETH figure in the November 2026 releases. No publication date could be confirmed for this figure, so it is likely a stale/earlier-2026 report rather than a genuine current conflict, but it is flagged here since it could not be dated and excluded with confidence.
